chain_words.nuance: to keep something out of sight
to make something hard to see or understand
to put something where it cannot be found
to hide wrongdoing deliberately from others
to prevent information from being known, often by force or authority

explanation: These words all describe keeping facts from view, from simple concealment to forcibly stopping the truth from being known.

usage_notes.difference: 'Hide' means putting something out of sight; 'suppress' means preventing information from becoming known, often through the use of authority.
